propositions: max_consecutive_repeat only detects adjacent identical tool signatures and is blind to cycles of length >= 2, scoring a genuine 4-cycle as 1 while healthy breadth scores 5

a windowed distinct-ratio metric (cardinality of trailing 24 signatures / 24, trip at <= 0.50) is order-insensitive and detects all cycle lengths, firing at calls 88+ on pathological traces while never firing on healthy runs
the distinct_ratio_window field must be None when fewer than REPETITION_WINDOW signatures exist to prevent false positives on short all-identical prefixes
module constants REPETITION_WINDOW=24 and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO=0.50 must be shared across three consumers: _repetition_summary producer, c827 actuator, and aec1 recorder
existing repetition counters and privacy contract (argument hashing) remain unchanged; the new signal is additive to the sidecar contract
